name: King Fleshpound (Sett)
creator: sauronkaiser
description:
Base champion: Sett

Skin: Any (only tested in default)

Author: Sauronkaiser

Description: King Fleshpound, from Killing Floor 2

Features:

-New model and textures.

-New full set of animations.

-New animations added to the set.

-New sounds.

-New particles

-New Splashart loading screen.

-New Ability icons and HUD.

-British humor included.

-Quarterpounds also included.

-A decent third game not included.

Credits and references:

-Most animations made by me, some extracted from KF2 and modified.

-Models extracted from Killing floor 1 and 2.

-The joke emote references the Pillar Men music from JoJo's bizarre adventure.

-The taunt emote has a cameo to Top Gear.

-The dance emote features "Spike Grinder", which is the theme of King Fleshpound in Killing Floor 2.

-The laugh emote references one of the episodes of Rick Stein Long Weekends (a british gastronomy series) in Cadiz, Spain. This is the exact moment referenced: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1-PxXUjJ_iw

-The respawn emote references the Trader from Killing Floor 1.

-Special thanks to HarpyQueen for helping with the textures.

-Special thanks to Aurecueil for the repathing.
